description: This file defines the base class `SugarFieldBase` for handling various field types within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for rendering templates, formatting data, handling search and import inputs, and managing field properties relevant to CRM data display and manipulation.

classes.name: SugarFieldBase
classes.description: A base class for CRM field types that provides common methods for rendering, formatting, searching, and handling field data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the field object with a specified type and creates an instance of Sugar_Smarty for templating.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches and returns a Smarty template output with additional HTML elements like buttons or images if configured.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Determines the appropriate template file path for a given view, with support for language-specific templates and custom overrides.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Placeholder method to format raw field data; meant to be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: unformatField
methods.description: Placeholder method to unformat formatted field data; meant to be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: getSmartyView
methods.description: Prepares Smarty variables and renders a template for a specified view.

methods.name: getListViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty output for list view display of a field.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty output for detail view display of a field.

methods.name: getChangeLogSmarty
methods.description: Formats field data for change log display, defaulting to simple formatting.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty output for editing a field, respecting readonly parameters.

methods.name: getImportViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty output for import views, similar to edit view.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty output for search form views.

methods.name: getPopupViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares Smarty output for popup views, defaulting to search view.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Returns a formatted value suitable for email templates.

methods.name: displayFromFunc
methods.description: Handles dynamic rendering of field values via callback functions or templates.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Placeholder for subclasses to define specific edit view rendering.

methods.name: getSearchWhereValue
methods.description: Returns the search value for use in building SQL WHERE clauses; can be overridden for specific types.

methods.name: getSearchInput
methods.description: Retrieves the input value from associated request arguments for search forms.

methods.name: getQueryLike
methods.description: Placeholder for generating 'LIKE' query logic.

methods.name: getQueryIn
methods.description: Placeholder for generating 'IN' query logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes Smarty variables and attributes, including buttons, images, and display parameters.

methods.name: getAccessKey
methods.description: Retrieves appropriate access keys and labels for UI elements based on localization labels.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field value into the bean, optionally trimming based on field type.

methods.name: isTrimmable
methods.description: Checks if a field type is eligible for trimming.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes imported data based on field length and type.

methods.name: isRangeSearchView
methods.description: Determines if a range-based search view should be displayed for the field.

methods.name: setupFieldArray
methods.description: Formats and sets up values in parent field arrays or objects, applying field-specific formatting.
